{{Quote|I ''regret'' this demonstration. I merely struck his ''servomotor central''. He'll be ''fine''.|A reprogrammed [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]], after deactivating a [[Unidentified fifth-degree droid|fifth-degree droid]]|<ref name="Droids 3">[[Droids (1995) 3|''Droids'' (1995) 3]]</ref>}}
The '''servomotor central''' powered a [[Droid/Legends|droid's]] [[Servomotor/Legends|servomotors]] and fluidic systems. It received input from the droid's [[Behavioral circuitry matrix/Legends|behavioral circuitry matrix]].
